description: Search 567politics reporting, parties, factions, politicians, country systems and policy issues to answer political questions. Accepts a question or keywords; optional country name/slug and kind filters. Read articles with get_article using the returned article_id; read profiles with get_politics_profile. Cite canonical page links, primary sources and dates; distinguish editorial estimates, facts and gaps. Public research needs no login.
name: search_politics
title: Research a political question with 567politics
